neighbours.label: function words and punctuation next to video game titles in gaming text
fire: I spent most of high school playing early builds of Minecraft and Terraria with friends.
The developer announced a second expansion for its online shooter, Destiny 2.
My favorite console games were Halo, Gears of War, and Mass Effect.
Blizzard has released the first patch for its strategy game StarCraft II today.
Fans of Dark Souls and Bloodborne will feel at home in this game.
After years of World of Warcraft, I switched to Final Fantasy XIV.
The beta version of Fortnite had no building mode at all.
Valve's multiplayer hit, Team Fortress 2, still has thousands of players.
quiet: I spent most of high school watching early seasons of Friends and Seinfeld with my sister.
The studio announced a second sequel for its spy thriller, Mission: Impossible.
My favorite novels were Dune, The Hobbit, and Watership Down.
The publisher has released the first paperback edition of its novel Middlemarch today.
Fans of The Godfather and Goodfellas will feel at home in this film.
After years of reading Agatha Christie, I switched to Raymond Chandler.
The early draft of the screenplay had no ghost scene at all.
Pixar's animated hit, Toy Story 2, still draws thousands of viewers.

notes: Card: every top example is a comma/of/for/and right before or after a video game title (Star Wars: The Old Republic, Counter-Strike, Ground Control, World of Warcraft). Near misses swap in film/book titles with the same syntax.
